note: ADB MDM Bypass op (adb_mdm_bypass) ki config. dns_hostname me APNA private-DNS hostname likho jo setup ke doran phone par darj karna hai (wo hostname jo MDM/plugin ke servers block kare). Kisi teesri party ki DNS service ka hostname yahan pehle se NAHI likha gaya — ye technician ki apni choice hai. Khali ho to op DNS wala qadam sirf rehnumai ke tor par log karega aur wahan ruk kar batayega ke pehle yahan hostname bhara jaye.
